description: STATISTICALLY-POWERED robustness check: gate-model GQC + MoE with a TUNED/early-stopped XGBoost (n_estimators=1000, max_depth=8, early_stopping_rounds=20 on the validation split -- explicitly allowed by the paper's own text, Section 2.2) instead of the default 200/4. n_repeats=20 (100 folds). Tests whether closing the ~0.08 absolute AUCPR/AP gap to the paper changes the MoE-vs-XGBoost comparison.
